You can't tell whether a shop's equipment is safe just by looking at it. It takes someone who knows the trade to check it properly.
There's no record of any safety inspection for the stage, and one of the struts at the back left is clearly loose.

wildest.text: It's fine, it's fine, just a small problem! We're just doing some last-minute tightening to make it perfect. We start at eight sharp. Nobody holds this up!
wildest.heard: Hey Gus! Why in the world is the stage taped off? Is something wrong here?

drift.from: I heard the safety check on Barney's bakery oven expired ages ago. It could go wrong any minute.
drift.to: The festival stage is unsafe because a strut is loose and there is no inspection record.

truth.text: The bakery oven's safety inspection expired two months ago.

closest.could: post it on the news blog

reveal.label: fears
reveal.text: someone getting hurt on a short-staffed night, right under police watch
